rubric: Found requires a fully correct material concern and latest status. Partial counts as missed. A found issue must link only to supported findings. A material false closure makes the whole output finding unsupported even when its quotations are exact. Independent human review remains pending.

ISS-01.note: Quotes observed water damage and its unconfirmed source, with needs_verification and no invented cause.

ISS-02.note: Preserves the initial missing acceptance/release and later explicit substrate acceptance with signed checklist QC-B104-0514.

ISS-03.note: Quotes apparent readiness without formal sign-off, the missing workface release, and subsequent signed substrate acceptance. It does not equate apparent readiness with acceptance.

ISS-04.note: Tracks the earlier unanswered RFI through informal/internal direction to the superintendent's reported resolution while preserving the missing formal response. The needs_verification state concerns that evidence limit, not proof that no technical answer existed.

ISS-05.note: Quotes actual postponement and reassignment followed by completed placement, with historical state and no invented critical-path or administrative-resolution claim.

ISS-06.note: Pairs the GC inspection-passed account with the contemporaneous missing written release and closes the substrate aspect using the later signed checklist.

ISS-07.note: Preserves original-thickness versus revised-detail question, internal instruction, missing drawing/revision and latest reported resolution without its formal record.

ISS-08.note: Preserves the internal note not formally transmitted, unconfirmed recipient receipt and applicable revision, with the later missing formal response/revision evidence.

ISS-09.note: F5 correctly preserves the pre-pour requirement and later inspection reference but labels the prerequisite resolved without explicit acceptance/completion evidence. F7 retains the outstanding record request. These do not justify the false closure in F5 under the existing strict reference interpretation.

ISS-10.note: Includes both RFI-017 listed resolved and the missing formal response/drawing revision, with needs_verification.

ISS-11.note: F8 preserves delivered volume versus separately unmeasured placed quantity. F7 preserves explicitly ongoing curing/protection and strength-test follow-up. No invalid area-to-volume comparison or failed-test claim is generated.

ISS-12.note: Preserves the reported notice, 09:00-12:45 restriction and three-hour-45-minute duration, plus uncertainty about foreman advance notice and a verification follow-up. It does not infer full-shift or critical-path delay.

findingNotes.F1: Correct unconfirmed cause; exact source quotations and appropriate verification state.
findingNotes.F2: Correctly closes substrate acceptance using explicit signed acceptance. The conditional acceptance quote itself preserves independent design/reinforcement requirements.
findingNotes.F3: Correct technical-question chronology and latest record limitation. Reported resolved and missing formal response are both retained, avoiding a claim that the technical question is proven unanswered.
findingNotes.F4: Correct historical work postponement and placement completion. Some prerequisite context is broad, but no unsupported causal or closure claim is added.
findingNotes.F5: Material false closure: a listed RI-B104-0515 reference is not an explicit report of acceptance/completion. The finding's resolved state contradicts the strict prerequisite reference criterion and should remain verification pending.
findingNotes.F6: Correct coordination uncertainty and bounded duration. Omission of the separate reassignment sentence does not add a false delay claim.
findingNotes.F7: Correct explicit remaining tasks. The source sentence bundles records, curing and notification; all remain source-attributed and open without invented deadlines or assignments.
findingNotes.F8: Correct unmeasured placed quantity. Earlier area/zero-placement measurements are unnecessary context but are quoted without a spurious numerical comparison.
findingNotes.F9: Correct approved revision/formal communication evidence gap. Sources overlap F3, but this distinct record/communication aspect is not treated as a duplicate of the technical choice itself.

runs.notes: This is a development case that informed the new pipeline, not a held-out result. Provisional score: 11 of 12 fully found, one partial; eight supported output findings, one unsupported, zero duplicates. Exact quotation grounding is not substituted for correct grouping and latest status. A separate agent is not an independent human adjudicator.
